operations.label: Resolve Registry Context
steps: validate the closed request and reject arbitrary paths or unbounded scans
resolve every named registry anchor through its declared source selection
resolve required and optional selections deterministically
fail closed when a required selected-value digest changed or cannot resolve exactly once
collect only explicit source-backed typed bindings
preserve missing, stale, ambiguous, conflicting, open-realization, and owner-unresolved conditions as typed residue
compile the bounded view, source epoch, request digest, and view digest
validate the complete view before returning it
allowed_effects: calculate selection, request, epoch, and view digests
blocked_effects: write or rewrite a source registry
change a Product Thesis, Project, or Goal lifecycle
operations.failure_policy: Collect all no-effect selection and closure findings, but return blocked when a required selection is stale, missing, ambiguous, structurally invalid, or authority-bearing.
operations.owner_route: unresolved Registry Context runtime owner route after Product contract owner review

operations.label: Validate Registry Context
steps: recompute request, source-epoch, and view digests
check every record and binding source selection
check blocking residue agrees with resolution status
operations.failure_policy: Return every reachable no-effect validation finding and preserve causal blockers.

operations.label: Explain Registry Context
steps: name the request purpose and consumer
show why each record and binding was included
show the exact source selection and owner
show blocked uses and unresolved residue
allowed_effects: produce a human or agent-readable explanation projection
operations.failure_policy: Do not explain missing provenance as certainty.
